status.description: metrics are empty unless OK; FAILED/MISSING are counted, never dropped

ssim.description: luma BT.601, Gaussian sigma 1.5, mean over mask

lpips.description: AlexNet v0.1, lower = more similar; spatial mean over mask when mask is partial

det_found.description: YuNet (thr 0.7) finds a face in the output

id_cos.description: SFace cosine(output, clean reference), fixed alignment

imp_cos_mean.description: mean SFace cosine(output, other population references)

imp_n.description: number of impostor comparisons (other population references)

imp_n_ge_thr.description: impostor comparisons at/above the FAR 1e-2 threshold

id_ge_thr.description: genuine cos at/above the FAR 1e-2 threshold (TAR numerator)
